title: Wingy Manone record date
summary: On the Joe Marsala/Wingy Manone date, Wingy talked away the rest of the session; Roy recalls his first sight of him.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: My first record date: sessions, personnel, discography

blocks.x: Was that when you made that record with Joe Marsala and them, at that same time?
You told me once that Wingy Manone was like the recording director...

Well, it was his date! It was his date. And we made these two tunes, and they came out so good, he talked the rest of the date. So we still were supposed to do two more tunes. Never got a chance to do 'em. Heh-heh. Another ...(?)... right? Yeah, I had many of those things. That's right! Yeah, Wingy talked the rest of the date. That was a nice date, too.
Wingy was a funny cat, man. The first time I saw Wingy was in the Twenties. He was doing a single with Al Scott's(?) band in Indianapolis. When I met him, he was

trying to play like ...(?)... And they would feature him. He said, "Man, I want to come and play with you cats. Them cats ain't swingin'!" Heh-heh-heh. He probably came over and played with us, you know. He was a good cat, man.
He's still around and living in Vegas, but he's not playing.
I mean, he's not really getting any work. I think he would if somebody would hire him.
He came back here once, didn't he?
Well, he came while I was at Ryan's. He came here with Bing or something or other, before Bing died.
Maybe something like that. But he hasn't played in a club in a long time.
